topic: core:stellar_populations (no numbered topic folder; closed Test Cards T002, T008, T014)
system: Low-mass stars in old globular clusters passing once through the red giant branch and the horizontal branch, and cooling white dwarfs in the Galactic disk.

mapping.F: nuclear fuel available in a phase (H shell on the RGB, core He on the HB) or the thermal energy of a white dwarf, F ~ T_c
mapping.P: luminosity; regulated burner n = 0 for RGB and HB (lifetime = fuel / luminosity from stellar models), Mestel cooling L ~ T_c^(7/2) so n = 7/2 for white dwarfs
mapping.b: common formation rate for RGB and HB (cancels in the ratio); constant birth rate of white dwarfs over the fitted range

parameters.name: tau_HB_over_tau_RGB
parameters.source: Ayala et al. 2014 stellar-model fit, with Y from low-metallicity H II regions

parameters.name: luminosity_power_of_core_temperature
parameters.source: Mestel 1952 cooling law, registered with HU2007_SDSS_DA_WD_LF

observable.quantity: R = N_HB/N_RGB in globular clusters; slope d log10 N / d M_bol of the white dwarf luminosity function
observable.test_card: T002, T014, T008 (closed; the engine pilot reproduces them and does not re-decide them)

legacy.status: T002 and T008 producers do not run after the root relocation (ROOT and docs.core import); their recorded numbers are reproduced by core/03_lanes/persistence/engine_pilot_stars.py

note: The AYALA14 data are both the source of tau_HB/tau_RGB (model fit and Y) and of the T002 comparison value R_ave; they are different rows of one registered file, as fixed in Test Card T002.
